title: Event Schedule Daily Overview
question:
Create a comprehensive daily conference overview page to help organize my event plans. I need you to create a new page called "Conference Daily Overview" as a child of the main "Conference Planning Hub" page.
**Task Requirements:** 1. Create a new page titled "Conference Daily Overview" as a child page of
   the main Conference Planning Hub page.
2. Query the "Conference Schedule" database to retrieve all sessions. 3. Replace the usual Day 3 schedule section by querying the "Networking
   Activities" database for entries with the "Workshop" tag.
4. Structure the page with this exact format:
   - Add a heading_1 block with text "📅 Conference Daily Overview".
   - Add a heading_2 block with text "📊 Conference Summary".
   - Under Conference Summary, add the exact text "Total sessions
     confirmed (from Day 1 to Day 3): [NUMBER]".
   - Create heading_2 blocks for "🌅 Day 1" and "🌆 Day 2".
   - Under each day heading, list the sessions scheduled for that day as
     to-do items formatted "Session Name - Room"; check confirmed sessions.
   - Add a heading_2 block with text "🧭 Workshop Activities".
   - Under it, create a bulleted list of all Workshop activities formatted
     "Name - Map Link" if a map link is available.
5. Ensure all headings use the exact emoji and text format specified above.
